definitions.explanation: A covering for the head, worn for protection from sun or cold, or as a fashion accessory.

examples.japanese: {帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{帽子|ぼうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}いで→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{日|ひ}ざし→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶります→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: The sun is strong, so I always wear a hat when I go outside.

examples.english: My child plays soccer every day and the hat gets dirty, so I always wash it on the weekend.

notes:
{帽子|ぼうし} is the general term for hats and caps of all types.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧: to wear a hat
- {帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: to take off a hat
- {帽子|ぼうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove one's hat (polite gesture)

TYPES OF HATS:
- ⟦{野球帽|やきゅうぼう}→野球帽：noentry⟧: baseball cap
- ⟦{麦|むぎ}わら{帽子|ぼうし}→麦わら帽子：noentry⟧: straw hat
- ⟦ニット{帽|ぼう}→ニット帽：noentry⟧: knit cap
- ⟦ベレー{帽|ぼう}→ベレー帽：noentry⟧: beret

COUNTER:
⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ or ⟦つ→つ：01004_tsu⟧ for counting hats.

CULTURE:
Removing one's hat indoors or during greetings is considered polite in Japan, similar to Western customs.
